treaty_name: Agreement between the Kingdom of Norway and the Republic of Macedonia for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2011)
eif_quote: Lovdata metadata: "Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 01-11-2011" | Art. 26: "The Agreement shall enter into force on the date of receipt of the last notification. 2. The Agreement shall be applicable: a. in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year next following the year in which the Agreement enters into force;"
source_title: Lovdata Norges traktater (English version), Agreement Norway-Macedonia 2011 (Norwegian, Macedonian, English equally authentic)

rates.quote: a. 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b. 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (MLI not in force for North Macedonia; no general anti-abuse/PPT article in the Agreement)

notes: Not MLI-covered: North Macedonia has signed but not ratified the MLI (per map.json), so no PPT and no Art. 8 holding period. Art. 10(4): dividends derived by the Government (Central Bank of Norway, Government Pension Fund, Norfund, Central Bank of Macedonia) taxable only in that State (not modelled). Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source when paid to a Government/subdivision/central bank/wholly state-owned institution, on export-promotion loans granted/insured/guaranteed by a governmental institution, or in connection with credit sales of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment (not modelled).
